en: A monochrome winter scene showing a fortified town with several large, round or slightly polygonal stone towers and high walls among snow‑covered buildings. Bare tree branches dominate the foreground, including a thick, gnarled tree trunk on the right. The landscape appears slightly misty, suggesting cold weather. Handwritten numbers are visible along the bottom edge of the image.
